compact.description: Return source health only: status, latest_error, last_run_at and one summary row per table. Defaults to true. Set to false for connection settings and full source configuration.

include_schemas.description: Include the `schemas` (tables) of each source. Set to false to get source-level fields only.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.
